project_info.theme: high-fashion black-and-white portrait with cigarette smoke

main_subject.description: An adult man with short light hair, expressive eyes, natural pores, fine facial texture, and a direct editorial gaze.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an ultra-realistic 4:5 high-fashion black-and-white portrait of an adult man with short light hair, expressive eyes, natural pores, fine facial texture, and a direct editorial gaze. He wears a dark tailored coat over a black turtleneck and holds a cigarette between his lips while soft smoke curls around his face. Frame a centered tight portrait against a minimal architectural background with soft geometric planes and no readable text or logos. Use a Hasselblad X2D medium-format camera with a 30mm lens, soft diffused daylight, controlled side contrast, a strong monochrome tonal range, subtle film grain, lifelike matte highlights, and crisp smoke wisps.
